Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Furnizori de divertisment
At WinVia Entertainment we are building a technology-led entertainment business that delivers exceptional experiences across multiple markets and channels.
 The WinviaTeam: Smart, Passionate, Purpose-Driven. 
 How do we work at Winvia? In short, we are a team committed to delivering exceptional entertainment experiences.
 We pride ourselves on being smart and efficient, but also passionate about what we do.
 While driven by a passion for innovation, we take decisions based on data-driven insights and a genuine desire to create trustworthy and engaging entertainment that resonates with our users.
 We are currently recruiting a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team!
 As a BI specialist, you will be a key player in our team, helping to develop BI solutions as well as providing data analysis services to various internal stakeholders (Acquisition, Finance, Product Development, Compliance etc.). 
 Responsibilities: 
Support internal stakeholders with appropriate data analysis and help them making decisions
Translate business needs into data requirements and closely collaborate with data engineers to ensure the right data sets are in place
Build, improve or redesign dashboards that provide stakeholders with key insights
Follow best practices in terms of data manipulation and visualization
Answer ad hoc questions and proactively identify opportunities to drive marketing strategies and insights
Maintain & improve existing dashboards & reports
Present data and findings in a clear, easy to understand way
Consult and train end-users to ensure high adoption of developed reports
 Qualifications and Experience: 
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related field
5+ years of experience working with in analytics and data
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (PowerBI preferably)
Hands-on experience with SQL (database interrogation, data manipulation)
Knowledge of cloud-based data storage and processing is a plus
Online gaming experience is highly appreciated
Ability to uncover hidden insights in large data sets
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey clear and concise messages
Detail-oriented and focused on results
Self-learning with a can-do attitude
 Offer for the role: 
Great place to work in a multinational fast-growing company where you can use your knowledge and ideas to re-shape current processes.
Hybrid working setup 2 days/week office work.
We encourage fresh ideas and value the diverse perspectives our employees bring to the table;
Competitive salary, rewards & bonuses, private medical insurance;
A cutting-edge office environment equipped with a selection of beverages including coffee, tea, soft drinks, and fresh fruits - daily
